== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[Captain Peavey (Errata 3)]]: the PC card image of [[Captain Peavey (Errata 2)]] (8 December 2025, [[:File:V8-D-captainpeavey.gif|V8-D-captainpeavey.gif]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (page 5). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
